title: The Return
hook: Shams came back to Konya. Then he vanished, and no one found him.

segments.fa: بروید ای حریفان بکشید یار ما را
segments.en: Go, my friends. Bring my beloved back.

segments.fa: به من آورید آخر صنم گریزپا را
segments.en: Bring me, at last, the idol who keeps running away.

segments.fa: بکشید سوی خانه مه خوب خوش‌لقا را
segments.en: Draw the lovely, bright-faced moon back home.

tafsir: Rumi sent his son, Sultan Walad, to Damascus to bring Shams home.
Many hear this ghazal as that call. We cannot be sure.
Shams came back. But the old jealousy came back too.
Then one day, Shams was gone. This time, for good.
Legends say he was killed. Historians are not sure.

outro.say: Part seven. Rumi searches Damascus. What does he find? Follow The Guest House.
outro.title: Part 7 · Rumi searches, and finds Shams within
